title: The package name '…' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.
summary: Try changing the name to follow the lower_case_with_underscores style. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: The package name '{}' isn't a lower_case_with_underscores identifier.

title: The library name is not a dot-separated path prefixed by the package name.
summary: Try changing the name to '…'. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: The library name is not a dot-separated path prefixed by the package name.

title: Structs must have at most one 'Packed' annotation.
message_templates: Structs must have at most one 'Packed' annotation.

title: Only packing to 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 bytes is supported.
summary: Try changing the 'Packed' annotation alignment to 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16.
message_templates: Only packing to 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 bytes is supported.

title: Invalid assignment to the parameter '…'.
summary: Try using a local variable in place of the parameter. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.

title: Expected this library to be part of '…', not '…'.
summary: Try including a different part, or changing the name of the library in the part's part-of directive.
message_templates: Expected this library to be part of '{}', not '{}'.

title: The 'part of' directive can't use a name with the enhanced-parts feature.
summary: Try using 'part of' with a URI instead.

title: The library is unnamed. A URI is expected, not a library name '…', in the part-of directive.

title: The path '…' doesn't exist.
summary: Try creating the referenced path or using a path that exists.
